screens.screen: chat screen (group) with a recovered deleted message and a repeated-message badge

notes: App name in the UI is 'WA Saver' (AppStrings.appName). Colours are the app's own AppColors (WhatsApp-like greens); no third-party logo is used anywhere. All conversations/messages are neutral sample data (work chat, delivery update, appointment reminder, service centre). Filter chips are drawn exactly as coded: the selected chip has the same colour as the app bar and unselected labels use bodyMedium black54 on the green bar, so they look low-contrast - that is the code, not a drawing error. Chat bubbles are all left-aligned (received notifications only) with the time at the bottom-right inside a 60px right padding, as coded. The app is Android-only (notification listener) but the shared kit's iOS-style status bar was used per the brief. Font: GoogleFonts Cairo, loaded from a local Cairo copy.
